segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין מַשְׁחִיזִין אֶת הַסַּכִּין בְּיוֹם טוֹב, אֲבָל מַשִּׂיאָהּ עַל גַּבֵּי חֲבֶרְתָּהּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One» may «not sharpen a knife on a Festival» in the ordinary weekday manner. «However, one» may do so in an unusual fashion, e.g., to «run» one knife «over another,» thereby sharpening the blade.

moves.summary: no sharpening; running over another knife permitted

positions.claim: one may not sharpen a knife but may run it over another knife
